text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives well-wishers on anniversary of July 17, 1968 revolution.
- Vice-chairman of the Revolutionary Command Council Izzat Ibrahim lays a wreath to the unknown soldier on July revolution anniversary.
- Egyptian authorities foil a new Kuwaiti lie that Iraq was behind the drowning of a Kuwaiti child in Cairo.
